pr_title: add extra example of creating a repo in an organization
pr_body:
This PR adds an extra example of creating a repository inside an organization. 

Fixes [https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/8340](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/8340)
pr_comments: Yeh I think this was addressed in parallel by https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/9309. We just didn't recognise that it would have closed the issue. Suggest closing this, sorry for the confusion and thanks for your contribution.

issue_context.title: gh repo create missing org flag
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

While trying to create repositories with `gh repo create` there is no option to create a repository within an organization.

### Proposed solution

Looking for a `-o` or `--org` flag  so we don't have to create a repository, and then transfer it to the correct organization.

### Additional context
comments:
@ndrone-kr You can specify the owner of the repo using this syntax `gh repo create OWNER/REPO`. This will allow you to create a repo within an organization. From the docs this is not clear so I can understand how this functionality was overlooked. I think we should expand the docs for `repo create` to include an example using this syntax. @ndrone-kr do you think that would have been enough to help you discover this functionality? 

Somewhat similar to https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/8147.
@samcoe yes that should resolve the original ask thank you
@samcoe I raised a PR for this https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/9715. Nothing major. Just an extra example. Please take a look.

review_comments: This seems duplicative of lines 110 & 111. Which is better, do you think, this change or the original example, and why?
